name: @bigcommerce/catalyst
description: Catalyst is BigCommerce's composable front-end framework designed for building custom ecommerce storefronts.

scripts.postbuild: node -e "if(process.env.ANALYZE!=='true')process.exit(0);const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(process.cwd(),'core','.next','analyze');const dst=path.join(process.cwd(),'core','public','analyze');try{if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.log('[analyze] no .next/analyze found at',src);process.exit(0);}fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of ['client.html','server.html','edge.html','nodejs.html']){const s=path.join(src,f);if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.copyFileSync(s,path.join(dst,f));console.log('[analyze] copied',f);}else{console.log('[analyze] missing',f);}}}catch(e){console.error('[analyze] copy failed',e);process.exit(0);}"
scripts.build:stub: dotenv -e .env.stub -- pnpm --filter @bigcommerce/catalyst-client build && dotenv -e .env.stub -- pnpm --filter @bigcommerce/catalyst-core build
